description: New Priority-specific synthetic case (tiny impact, severe gap, but still statistically valid) — 'Tiny Severe Channel': 100 clicks / 0 conversions, peers (leave-one-out control) 50,000 clicks at CVR 6.0% combined, total 50,100 clicks. test_baseline_value = 3000/50000 = 0.06 exactly (peers only). Independently computed: normal-approximation gate passes (100*p=5.99>=5 etc.), z ~= -2.53 (|z| >= 1.96) -> evaluation_level = high, direction = below. Deliberately eligible (not insufficient_data) — the point under test is that even a statistically valid, severe-gap anomaly stays a Low Priority when its own traffic share is negligible.
